WITH member_attendance AS (
    SELECT m.member_id, m.position, COUNT(a.link_to_event) AS attendance_count
    FROM member AS m
    JOIN attendance AS a ON a.link_to_member = m.member_id
    GROUP BY m.member_id, m.position
), total_attendance AS (
    SELECT SUM(attendance_count) AS total_count
    FROM member_attendance
)
SELECT ma.member_id,
       ma.position,
       ma.attendance_count,
       CAST(ma.attendance_count AS REAL) / ta.total_count AS share_of_all_attendance
FROM member_attendance AS ma
CROSS JOIN total_attendance AS ta
ORDER BY share_of_all_attendance DESC
LIMIT 10;
